title: Trial of Perseverance
summary: Keep the gong's defenders occupied and defeat twelve goblins to draw out their warlord.
overview: Keep the gong's defenders occupied and defeat twelve goblins to draw out their warlord.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Maintain aggression on the goblins and prevent any disengaged defender from ringing the gong.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Tell Osashi 'ready' to summon four goblins and begin the trial.
Killed goblins are replaced until twelve kills have been credited without a bell failure.
At twelve credited kills, the Stillmoon warlord appears.
Engaging a goblin cancels its bell timers; a disengaged goblin starts a warning followed by the bell. A bell failure summons an Ancient Stillmoon Guardian.

notes: Approval R018. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Publication blocker: Goblin_Spawn is defined twice; the second definition overwrites the initial timer setup. Exact idle-start/failure timing must be fixed or live-verified before publication.
